runtime_scope: 32 spread validation scans, actual process_frame (both display grids + object clustering + curb ribbons) plus JSON serialization. Input disk read, compressed cache write, HTTP and browser excluded. CPU RSS sampled after frame; GPU allocator peak reset per frame.

cells.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap; block=16 evaluated frames; 1000 draws

bytes.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap; block=16 evaluated frames; 1000 draws

grid_ms.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap; block=16 evaluated frames; 1000 draws

near_cell_miou.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap; block=16 evaluated frames; 1000 draws

failure_gallery.name: far pedestrian / rider
failure_gallery.scope: GT-selected challenge crop; worst observed candidate, not representative accuracy

failure_gallery.name: thin pole / sign
failure_gallery.scope: GT-selected challenge crop; worst observed candidate, not representative accuracy

failure_gallery.name: curb / sidewalk boundary
failure_gallery.scope: GT sidewalk points within 1m XY of GT road; semantic adjacency proxy, not surveyed curb height

test.label_status: Private official test labels. No local accuracy score; never used for training or tuning.

limitations.weather_lighting: No verified per-frame metadata available; no invented strata.
limitations.tracking: No validated tracker. ID switches, tracking precision/recall and velocity error unavailable.
limitations.curb_height_error: No surveyed curb ground truth. Elevation metrics are compression error against raw-scan 5cm GT statistics.
limitations.occupancy: Observed obstacle-semantic IoU only; no free-space ray ground truth.
limitations.elevation: Macro-averaged per-frame elevation errors against raw LiDAR fine-cell stats; not independent surveyed elevation truth.
limitations.scene_types: GT composition strata, not verified urban/highway/residential tags.
limitations.coverage: Sequence 08 is validation and was used for checkpoint/runtime selection. Paired CIs use moving-block bootstrap; not an untouched test score.
limitations.boundary: Per-frame boundary_incell_distance is a mixed-GT-cell boundary proxy, not annotated curb distance.
limitations.temporal: Only consecutive scanned frames with poses; nearest-cell overlap proxy, not object tracking.

coverage.selection: Frozen evenly spaced selection from paired files available when run began; later downloads are not silently included.

turn_response.scope: 16 validation frames; speed fixed 60km/h; headings 0, +18, -18, +90 degrees; cached segmentation; CPU grid rebuild only, not browser/network latency. Changed leaves count symmetric difference of spatial origin+size sets.
